icp: who exactly has the problem, e.g. 5-20 person remote design teams (never 'everyone')
job: the job to be done, e.g. avoid file-version conflicts when several people edit together
current_workaround: how they cope today, e.g. Notion + a spreadsheet kept in sync by hand
demand_type: b2b-saas | consumer-app | physical-ecommerce | content-creator | developer-tool | open-source | general
buyer_vs_user: same person, or: the user is X, the payer is Y
pricing_assumption: e.g. $12 / seat / month, or free + paid hosting

claims.title: Pain exists
claims.go_criterion: >=2 independent sources quote the same complaint

claims.title: ICP match
claims.statement: the people in pain are the people you can serve and reach

claims.title: Payment holds
claims.statement: they pay for a fix (not just say they would)
claims.go_criterion: similar solutions show real payment: pricing pages, paid reviews, funding, revenue

claims.title: Model holds
claims.statement: the pricing / channel / form you bet on works
claims.go_criterion: >=1 live product with the same model that is growing
